# GitHub Copilot Prompts

This directory contains specialized prompts for different development tasks.

## Available Prompts

- `setup-component.md` - Setting up new components with proper structure
- `write-tests.md` - Writing comprehensive tests for components and functions  
- `code-review.md` - Performing thorough code reviews
- `refactor-code.md` - Refactoring code for better maintainability
- `generate-docs.md` - Generating comprehensive documentation
- `debug-issue.md` - Debugging complex issues systematically

## Usage

These prompts can be referenced in VS Code by typing `#file:.github/prompts/[prompt-name].md` in your Copilot chat.

Example:
```
#file:.github/prompts/setup-component.md

Create a new React component for user authentication
```
